draft.emotion: hopeful and reflective, believing in the possibility of a good outcome
notes: Commonly used in 'tener suerte' (to be lucky), 'por suerte' (luckily), and '¡Buena suerte!' or simply '¡Suerte!' (Good luck!).
Without an adjective, 'tener suerte' means to have good luck.
